tenderSchedule.title: RFP for providing Housekeeping Services to e-Procurement Cell, Centre For e-Governance.
tenderSchedule.description: RFP for providing Housekeeping Services to e-Procurement Cell, Centre For e-Governance.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have provided Housekeeping services to any commercial/ Private, Public, Govt. semi govt. institutions worth Rs 4 Lakhs every year in last 3 Financial years

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work order or work completion Certificates issued by the concerned department to be submitted. Minimum 3 certificates to be  provided.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Submission of Covering letter as required in the given format
Furnishing of the Power of Attorney
The bidder should have been registered with ESI, PF, Labour departments/ authorities in the state of Karnataka

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of registration certificate issued by these respective departments/authorities along with ESI and PF paid documents of at least last three years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should hold valid Good & Services Tax registration certificate(GST) and Permanent Account Number (PAN) issued by income tax department.
The bidder should have an annual turnover of at least 15 Lakhs, each year in last 3 years i.e. 2022-23, 2023-24,2024-25

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certified copy from Chartered Accountant as per Appendix-2 with valid UDIN number

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: SUBMIT ALL DOCUMENTS AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT

itemList.itemName: Providing Housekeeping services as per minimum wages including all taxes with consumables
